papers.title: Ridge Regression from Poisson Resetting: A Renewal Perspective on Spectral Regularization
papers.abstract: We connect stochastic resetting from non-equilibrium statistical physics with ridge regularization in statistical learning. For linear gradient flow, resetting to the origin at rate $r$ produces stationary mean $(X^\top X+rI)^{-1}X^\top y$, exactly the ridge estimator with penalty $λ=r$. This uses the known Laplace-transform relationship between ridge regression and exponential-time averaging of gradient flow, with the exponential time now interpreted as the stationary age associated with Poisson resetting. We then extend this identity to general renewal reset laws: the exponential reset time distribution is the unique renewal law whose stationary mean reproduces scalar ridge in every eigendirection as an exact filter identity for every positive curvature, while non-exponential renewal laws generate alternative spectral filters. At the fluctuation level, we study a separate additive Ornstein-Uhlenbeck extension with constant diffusion, interpreted as a stylized SGD approximation. In this setting, the equality holds only at the level of the mean, since the reset process has a nonzero stationary covariance from accumulated OU noise and reset-timing variance, whereas deterministic ridge is a fixed estimator with the same center. Stylized experiments compare the deterministic renewal-induced filters directly and illustrate when filters induced by non-exponential reset-time laws can differ predictively from ridge. The results for the stationary mean and the induced spectral filters are established for continuous-time gradient flow with isotropic resetting on quadratic objectives; the covariance and risk formulas additionally assume additive noise with state-independent covariance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：连接（connect）、推导（produce）、建立（establish）、理论框架（renewal perspective）。；研究对象：统计学习中的岭回归（ridge regression）与非平衡统计物理中的随机重置（stochastic resetting）之间的理论联系，具体研究线性梯度流在二次目标函数上的动力学行为。

papers.title: Critical exponents for planar random-cluster model with cluster-weight $q=4$
papers.abstract: Using the Baxter-Kelland-Wu coupling and the convergence of the height function of the six-vertex model to the Gaussian Free Field, we extract critical exponents for the planar critical random-cluster model at $q=4$, and the planar four-state Potts model.

papers.title: Lattice Brownian bees with cooperative reproduction: steady states, collapse, and spreading
papers.abstract: We extend the ``Brownian bees'' model of Berestycki et al. (2021, 2022) to cooperative reproduction, $kA\to(k{+}1)A$, of a population of $N$ symmetric random walkers with removal, at each birth event, of the particle farthest from the origin. Working in the limit $N\to\infty$, we formulate a hydrodynamic free-boundary problem for this model. Using this formalism, we determine steady state population densities for all~$k$ and prove their linear stability for $k\le 2$ and instability for $k\ge 4$. In the marginal case $k=3$, there is a whole continuous family of steady states at a single, critical ratio of the reproduction and diffusion rates. Above criticality the population undergoes an asymptotically self-similar finite-time collapse to the origin. Below the criticality the population spreads diffusively, but the reproduction remains quantitatively relevant. For $k\ge 4$, the unstable steady state separates regimes of a finite-time collapse and a diffusive spreading. Here the collapse dynamics is asymptotically self-similar, and the population density exhibits a scale separation requiring a matched-asymptotic description. Our analytical predictions are confirmed by numerical solutions of the hydrodynamic free-boundary problem and by Monte Carlo simulations of the original microscopic model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“formulate a hydrodynamic free-boundary problem”、“analytical predictions”、“numerical solutions”和“Monte Carlo simulations”，属于理论建模与数值模拟结合的研究。；研究对象：论文研究的是具有合作繁殖机制的“布朗蜜蜂”格子模型，具体为对称随机游走粒子群体在有限种群（N→∞极限）下的稳态、坍缩与扩散行为，涉及kA→(k+1)A的繁殖反应与每次出生事件中移除离原点最远粒子的规则。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于合作繁殖阶数k，稳态密度在k≤2时线性稳定，k≥4时不稳定；在临界k=3时存在连续稳态族。高于临界繁殖-扩散速率比时种群发生有限时间自相似坍缩至原点，低于临界时种群扩散性扩展但繁殖仍定量重要。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于合作繁殖阶数k，稳态密度在k≤2时线性稳定，k≥4时不稳定；在临界k=3时存在连续稳态族。高于临界繁殖-扩散速率比时种群发生有限时间自相似坍缩至原点，低于临界时种群扩散性扩展但繁殖仍定量重要。；创新点：将“布朗蜜蜂”模型从单粒子繁殖（k=1）推广至合作繁殖（k≥2），揭示了不同k值下稳态稳定性、临界行为以及有限时间坍缩与扩散扩展之间的相变机制，并给出了k≥4时需匹配渐近描述的尺度分离现象。

papers.title: Open Problem: Separating Geometric and Algorithmic Compression via Cayley-Table Completion
papers.abstract: Modern statistical learning theory and deep learning characterize generalization primarily in terms of continuous capacity control (e.g., norm-based regularization, margin maximization, low-rank bias). While highly successful in continuous domains, deep learning consistently fails to extrapolate exact algorithmic or discrete algebraic rules, reflecting a missing inductive bias toward algorithmic complexity minimization. We propose the Cayley-table completion as the canonical testbed for this missing bias, serving as the discrete algebraic counterpart to matrix completion. Just as matrix factorization combined with weight decay yields an implicit geometric bias toward low linear rank, recent results demonstrate that operator-valued tensor factorizations paired with a flatness prior yield an implicit algorithmic bias toward exact discrete associativity. We pose the open problem of establishing formal exact recovery bounds for Cayley-table completion, and challenge the community to generalize continuous flatness priors to autonomously discover broader discrete algorithmic axioms without combinatorial search.

papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体物理结论或发现，主要提出一个开放问题：如何建立Cayley-table补全的精确恢复理论界限，并挑战社区将连续平坦性先验推广到自动发现离散算法公理。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体物理结论或发现，主要提出一个开放问题：如何建立Cayley-table补全的精确恢复理论界限，并挑战社区将连续平坦性先验推广到自动发现离散算法公理。；创新点：将矩阵补全的几何低秩偏置推广到离散代数结构的算法复杂度最小化偏置，提出Cayley-table补全作为离散代数版本的规范测试问题，并指出当前深度学习缺乏对精确算法规则的外推能力。

papers.title: Gate Parameter Lee-Yang Zeros and Dynamical Phases in Quantum Circuits
papers.abstract: We propose gate-parameter Lee-Yang zeros of Loschmidt amplitudes as probes of dynamical phases in finite quantum circuits. We illustrate this approach using a brickwork model, where the time evolution is generated by repeated application of a Floquet operator. The Loschmidt amplitude can be expressed as a rational function of the gate parameters. At fixed system size and large circuit depth, its zeros in one complexified gate parameter, with the other parameter held fixed, condense onto limiting curves. We show that these curves comprise a universal component governed by equimodular Floquet eigenvalues, as described by the Beraha-Kahane-Weiss theorem, together with state-dependent contributions controlled by the overlap of eigenstate of the Floquet operator with the initial state. As one of the parameters is varied, the set of zeros reorganizes abruptly, providing a finite-qubit diagnostic of a dynamical phase transition. This mechanism does not rely on integrability: while integrability enables an exact calculation of the Loschmidt amplitude, the condensation of zeros follows from spectral competition and local unitarity alone.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提出理论概念（gate-parameter Lee-Yang zeros），并基于理论框架（Beraha-Kahane-Weiss定理、Floquet算子、谱竞争）进行分析，未提及实验或数值计算细节。；研究对象：有限量子电路中的动力学相，具体通过砖墙模型（brickwork model）中的Floquet时间演化来研究。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Loschmidt振幅在复化门参数中的零点会凝聚成极限曲线，这些曲线由等模Floquet本征值（通用部分）和初态与本征态重叠（态依赖部分）共同决定；当参数变化时，零点集发生突变，可作为有限量子比特系统中动力学相变的诊断工具。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Loschmidt振幅在复化门参数中的零点会凝聚成极限曲线，这些曲线由等模Floquet本征值（通用部分）和初态与本征态重叠（态依赖部分）共同决定；当参数变化时，零点集发生突变，可作为有限量子比特系统中动力学相变的诊断工具。；创新点：提出门参数Lee-Yang零点作为有限量子电路中动力学相的探针，揭示了零点凝聚的通用与态依赖双重来源，并证明该机制不依赖可积性，仅需谱竞争和局域幺正性。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：将Loschmidt振幅表示为门参数的有理函数，利用Beraha-Kahane-Weiss定理分析零点凝聚行为，并基于Floquet算子的谱竞争和局域幺正性解释机制。可积性仅用于精确计算Loschmidt振幅，但零点凝聚机制不依赖可积性。

papers.title: Low-Magnification SEM May Suffice: Interpretable Deep Learning for Multi-Scale Fracture-Cause Classification in Zirconia-Toughened Alumina
papers.abstract: Reliable identification of fracture origins in alumina matrix composite hip and knee implants is critical for quality assurance and patient safety, yet current fractographic workflows are time-consuming, partly subjective, and reliant on high-magnification scanning electron microscopy (SEM). We present an interpretable vision-transformer (ViT) workflow for automated classification of fracture causes in an alumina matrix composite (BIOLOX delta, CeramTec GmbH) widely used in total joint replacements. A dataset of 8,493 SEM images (50x-10,000x) was curated from five years of in-production burst and proof tests and annotated into three defect categories defined along the manufacturing chain: green body, hard machining, and material defects. Under severe class imbalance, the fine-tuned ViT reached an accuracy of 0.907 and a macro-F1 of 0.888 in stratified five-fold cross-validation, with a two-stage perceptual-hash/SSIM leakage audit confirming negligible specimen overlap. Notably, performance at low magnification (50x) was comparable to that at high magnification (1k-10kx), indicating that macro-scale features - mirror geometry and hackle line fields - already encode sufficient diagnostic signal. Grad-CAM attributions consistently localised on canonical fractographic cues (mirrors, hackles, pores, machining marks), aligning with established fractographic criteria. Together, these results position interpretable ViTs as a complementary tool for ceramic-implant quality assurance, enabling low-magnification pre-screening and reducing reliance on time-intensive high-magnification inspection.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：SEM图像、fractographic workflow、burst and proof tests（实验测试）。；研究对象：氧化锆增韧氧化铝（ZTA）陶瓷基复合材料（BIOLOX delta），用于全关节置换植入物（髋、膝关节）的断裂原因分类。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 低倍率（50x）SEM图像与高倍率（1k-10kx）图像在断裂原因分类上性能相当，表明宏观尺度的断裂特征（镜面几何、放射棱线场）已包含足够的诊断信息；可解释的视觉Transformer（ViT）在严重类别不平衡下达到0.907准确率和0.888宏F1分数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：低倍率（50x）SEM图像与高倍率（1k-10kx）图像在断裂原因分类上性能相当，表明宏观尺度的断裂特征（镜面几何、放射棱线场）已包含足够的诊断信息；可解释的视觉Transformer（ViT）在严重类别不平衡下达到0.907准确率和0.888宏F1分数。；创新点：首次将可解释的ViT应用于陶瓷植入物断裂原因的低倍率预筛选，证明低倍率SEM即可满足分类需求，减少对耗时的高倍率SEM检查的依赖。
papers.method_zh: 使用视觉Transformer（ViT）进行自动分类；数据集包含8493张SEM图像（50x-10000x），来自五年生产中的爆破和验证测试；采用分层五折交叉验证，并用感知哈希/SSIM进行泄漏审计；使用Grad-CAM进行可解释性分析。

papers.title: Community detection in subject-subject networks from psychometrics data
papers.abstract: Identifying subgroups of respondents in psychometric data is traditionally addressed with Latent Class Analysis, which requires the number of classes to be specified a priori and can perform poorly when strong inter-item correlations violate local independence assumptions. We propose a network-theoretic alternative based on community detection in subject-subject similarity networks. To suppress the systematic artifacts induced by the factor structure of the items, the similarity is computed in a low-dimensional factor-score space and the null model for modularity maximisation is obtained by removing the leading (global) mode of the similarity matrix, rather than via the standard Newman--Girvan model. The significance of a detected partition is then assessed against a column-wise resampling null through four complementary observables: the modularity, the differential entropy of the eigenvector point cloud at two neighbourhood scales, and the overlap of the within- and between-community similarity histograms. On a synthetic benchmark with controlled mixture signal, all four metrics correctly identify the homogeneous case as null-compatible -- including the demanding regime of a dataset dominated by a single factor -- and exhibit a graded departure from the null as the cluster separation grows. Applied to 14 widely used psychometric scales, the pipeline isolates a small group of datasets supporting a genuine and directly interpretable modular structure, while the remaining scales fall either in a mixed-signal regime or in one compatible with a single homogeneous community. The significance analysis is independent of the specific community-detection algorithm and provides an operational way to test for modular subject-level structure in questionnaire data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：network-theoretic alternative、community detection、null model、significance analysis。；研究对象：心理测量学数据中的被试者（respondents）子群识别问题。具体而言，是将被试者视为节点，基于其作答相似性构建网络，并研究该网络中的社区结构（即被试者的潜在分组）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于社区检测的网络分析方法，用于替代传统的潜在类别分析（LCA）来识别心理测量数据中的被试者子群。该方法能有效处理LCA中因项目间强相关而违反局部独立性假设的问题，并通过显著性检验区分出真正的模块化结构与均匀或混合信号的数据集。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于社区检测的网络分析方法，用于替代传统的潜在类别分析（LCA）来识别心理测量数据中的被试者子群。该方法能有效处理LCA中因项目间强相关而违反局部独立性假设的问题，并通过显著性检验区分出真正的模块化结构与均匀或混合信号的数据集。；创新点：1. 提出了一个针对心理测量学数据特点的、基于网络社区检测的替代分析框架。2. 改进了模块度最大化的零模型，通过移除因子结构导致的全局模式来更准确地反映数据的内在结构。3. 建立了一套独立于具体社区检测算法的、基于重采样的显著性检验流程，能够系统地区分真正的模块化结构、混合信号和均匀分布的数据集。
papers.method_zh: 1. **网络构建**：在被试者-被试者相似性网络中，相似度在低维因子得分空间（factor-score space）中计算，以抑制项目因子结构带来的系统伪影。2. **社区检测**：使用模块度最大化方法，但其零模型通过移除相似性矩阵的主（全局）模式获得，而非标准Newman-Girvan模型。3. **显著性评估**：通过列重采样（column-wise resampling）零模型，并利用四个互补可观测量（模块度、两个邻域尺度下的特征向量点云微分熵、以及社区内与社区间相似性直方图的重叠）来评估检测到的分区的统计显著性。

papers.title: Inverse generalised spin models of answers to questionnaires
papers.abstract: Network psychometrics conceptualises psychological constructs as emergent properties of systems of interacting variables. Energy-based probabilistic models have gained popularity as models of these interactions, but their psychometric application has so far been limited, since most implementations assume binary or ternary responses and rely on limiting inference assumptions. We infer and analyse three generalised spin models of ordinal questionnaire data: the generalised Ising, Blume-Capel (BC), and Blume-Emery-Griffiths (BEG) models. We prove the concavity of the maximum likelihood estimation of the parameters, as well as the gauge invariance of the Ising and BC models. Afterwards, we propose an inference protocol of approximated likelihood maximisation, based on the Monte Carlo estimation of the likelihood gradients. We apply this procedure to eleven psychometric and sociological questionnaires, comparing the inferred spin models against the multivariate Gaussian. We then assess whether the inferred models reproduce the empirical features of the data in terms of principal-component histograms, and histograms of Euclidean and Mahalanobis distances to the mean answer. The multi-modality observed in the histograms of principal components is partially captured by the spin models. This trait of polarisation can be understood, in the light of mean-field theory, as coexistence of stable and metastable phases of the spin models. The BEG model systematically outperforms the other models in capturing the distribution of distances to the mean, while all models underestimate the heavy tails of the Mahalanobis distance. Overall, the analysis witnesses the predictive power of the BEG model, able to account better than others for the abundance of outliers and mean responders, and reveals highly non-linear features of questionnaire data that both Gaussian and spin models fail to account for.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：energy-based probabilistic models、maximum likelihood estimation、Monte Carlo estimation、mean-field theory。；研究对象：问卷数据（心理测量学与社会学问卷）的广义自旋模型，具体包括广义伊辛模型、Blume-Capel (BC) 模型和 Blume-Emery-Griffiths (BEG) 模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: BEG模型在捕捉问卷数据中距离均值的分布方面系统性优于其他模型，能更好地解释异常值和均值响应者的丰度；但所有模型（包括高斯模型）均低估了马氏距离的重尾特征，表明问卷数据存在高度非线性特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：BEG模型在捕捉问卷数据中距离均值的分布方面系统性优于其他模型，能更好地解释异常值和均值响应者的丰度；但所有模型（包括高斯模型）均低估了马氏距离的重尾特征，表明问卷数据存在高度非线性特征。；创新点：将广义自旋模型（特别是BEG模型）系统应用于有序分类问卷数据，并利用平均场理论将观测到的多峰极化现象解释为自旋模型中稳定相与亚稳相的共存。摘要未突出说明与已有心理测量学模型的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于能量概率模型的推断框架：证明了参数最大似然估计的凹性以及伊辛和BC模型的规范不变性；采用基于蒙特卡洛估计似然梯度的近似似然最大化推断协议；将推断出的自旋模型与多元高斯模型进行对比，并通过主成分直方图、欧氏距离和马氏距离直方图评估模型对数据经验特征的复现能力。
